title: 礼貌用语与“没听懂”怎么办
goal: 掌握最常用的礼貌用语；没听懂时会请对方重复、说慢一点、写下来——这是听懂外国人的第一步。
tips: 没听懂千万别乱答 Yes。说 Sorry? 或 Pardon?（语调上扬），对方就会重复一遍。
Excuse me 用来引起注意（打扰一下、借过），Sorry 用来道歉；在英国，请人重复时也常说 Sorry?
地址、价格、时间这类信息听不清，就说 Could you write it down, please? 让对方写下来，最稳妥。

exchanges.reply: I'm good, thanks. How about you?
A little. Could you speak slowly, please?
exchanges.replyZh: 会一点。请您说慢一点好吗？

exchanges.reply: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?
exchanges.replyZh: 抱歉，我没听清。您能再说一遍吗？

exchanges.hear: The address is twenty-five Baker Street.
exchanges.reply: Could you write it down for me, please?

exchanges.hear: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
exchanges.hearZh: 打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？

exchanges.hear: Thank you so much for your help.

exchanges.reply: Yes, please. Where is the restroom?
exchanges.replyZh: 是的，谢谢。洗手间在哪里？

dialogue.title: 在机场向工作人员问路

lines.en: Excuse me. Do you speak English?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，您会说英语吗？

lines.en: Yes, I do. How can I help you?
Where is the taxi stand, please?
lines.zh: 请问出租车候车点在哪里？

lines.en: Go straight and turn left after the coffee shop. It's next to Exit B.
lines.zh: 直走，过了咖啡店左转，在B出口旁边。

lines.en: Sorry, could you speak more slowly, please?
Sure. Go straight. Turn left at the coffee shop. Exit B.
lines.zh: 好的。直走。在咖啡店左转。B出口。

lines.en: Exit B. I see. Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
